title: Fantastic experience
text: I can not say enough great things about this tour. Most especially because we booked so late and Alhambra tickets were sold out. Pilar is an excellent communicator and kept us updated on her efforts. We thought we would have to give up but she was successful! We had THE most perfect day trip from Sevilla to Granada. Our driver Curro was fantastic and our guide Clara was superb. We learned so much from her. Well done and highly recommend!
author: carolyncw2018
